scope: Replace the shared Mina opening/reaching portrait and its registered blink frame; retain the shooting artwork and existing animation.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent animated opening portrait for the original Japanese game Refrain.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the exact composition/pose template. Input 2 is the authoritative face and drawing-style reference: Mina's in-game conversation standing portrait. Input 3 is her shooting gameplay sprite, supporting identity, eyelids, costume colors and restrained cel shading ONLY; do NOT copy its chibi proportions.
Redraw input 1 in the SAME artist style and character identity as input 2 and input 3. The current opening portrait is overly glossy, painterly, soft and elaborate; make its eyes calmer and slightly half-lidded with straight restrained upper eyelashes, simpler blue irises with one or two plain highlights, a small reserved mouth, and the same clean facial contour as input 2. Use consistent fine dark charcoal/brown linework, clean flat color groups, a single clear cel-shadow step, much less hair strand rendering, and broad simple cloth folds. Silver-white hair with restrained lavender-gray shadows, blue eyes, navy maid dress, white frilled headband, white apron, navy neck bow and a blue brooch. The face should not look like a different girl. No glossy jewel-like multi-layer eyes, no airbrushed skin, no 3D doll rendering, no extra ornaments.
Preserve input 1's entire composition and silhouette: a single normal-proportioned waist-up Mina occupying the right half, the face at approximately x=1010,y=270 on a 1536x1024 canvas, head at the same angle, the same long hair flowing left across the lower half, left foreground open hand reaching toward the viewer at approximately x=760,y=680 and other hand resting near her chest. Keep the open palms and natural fingers intact. Preserve the hair's and apron ribbon's room to flow left. Do not center her, do not crop the headdress or fingers, do not add legs or a floor. Preserve image 1's positions so an existing hair-wind shader and eye blink region will still align. Use the existing outfit, not a new costume.
Output exactly one landscape 1536x1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background, including between hair strands. Clear alpha outside the character. Absolutely no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no vignette, no light cloud, no glow halo, no frame, no text. The gray and black behind the inputs are NOT part of the character and must not be painted into the output. Only change the drawing style and facial rendering to match the shooting character; retain the reaching-out narrative pose.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: registered blink frame for a 2D game's animated opening portrait.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly approved cel-shaded Mina opening art. Produce the same 1536x1024 transparent PNG, with ONLY her two eyes gently closed for a natural quiet blink. Replace the open irises and upper lids with two calm, simple closed eyelid lines that follow the exact existing eye angles. Match this flat cel-shaded style, restrained linework, skin tone and the original facial expression. Do not make her smiling, pained, sleeping or crying.
Registration is critical: Keep every other pixel's placement and all character proportions, face outline, eyebrows, nose, mouth, bangs, fringe positions, head angle, hands, reaching gesture, clothes, folds, headdress, flowing hair, ribbons and complete silhouette unchanged. Do not shift or zoom anything. Both eye regions are near x=945..1118,y=210..298 on this 1536x1024 image; edit the eyelids in place without changing the face.
Keep the background genuinely transparent and preserve the existing alpha including the gaps between hair strands. Do NOT render a black/gray gradient, glow, background, grid or checkerboard into transparent areas. Single identical frame except closed eyes; no text, captions, extra panels or objects.

finishing: None. Native generated 1536x1024 PNGs with alpha; no resizing, cutting or recoloring.
